description: This file contains unit tests for the CommandResolver component of the OpenClaw project, validating command-line invocation logic, path resolution, and SSH configuration handling.

classes.name: CommandResolverTests
classes.description: A test suite verifying the behavior of the CommandResolver component, including path resolution, command composition, and SSH command generation.

methods.name: makeDefaults
methods.description: Creates a unique UserDefaults suite to avoid conflicts during testing.

methods.name: makeLocalDefaults
methods.description: Initializes UserDefaults with local connection mode for testing.

methods.name: makeProjectRootWithPnpm
methods.description: Sets up a temporary project directory with pnpm installed and executable.

methods.name: prefers open claw binary
methods.description: Test verifying that the OpenClaw binary is preferred over other methods.

methods.name: falls back to node and script
methods.description: Test verifying fallback to node runtime and script execution.

methods.name: prefers open claw binary over pnpm
methods.description: Test ensuring that the openclaw binary is prioritized over the pnpm executable.

methods.name: uses open claw binary without node runtime
methods.description: Test confirming usage of openclaw binary directly without node runtime fallback.

methods.name: falls back to pnpm
methods.description: Test verifying fallback command when openclaw binary is absent.

methods.name: pnpm keeps extra args after subcommand
methods.description: Ensures extra arguments after subcommand are preserved in command execution.

methods.name: preferred paths start with project node bins
methods.description: Test validating that preferred search paths include project node bin directories.

methods.name: builds SSH command for remote mode
methods.description: Test that SSH command is correctly constructed when in remote mode.

methods.name: rejects unsafe SSH targets
methods.description: Test to verify detection and rejection of unsafe SSH target strings.

methods.name: config root local overrides remote defaults
methods.description: Test verifying that local configuration overrides remote default settings.
